name: EL, ELOAH
meaning: God "mighty, strong, prominent". Etymologically, El appears to mean “power” and “might”. Associated with integrity, jealousy, and compassion, but the root idea of “might” remains.
questions: How can remembering God's might (El) empower me when I feel weak or overwhelmed?
In what situation do I need to trust in God's prominence and strength over my own?
Reflect on a time God's power was evident in your life. How does this encourage your faith today?

name: ELOHIM
meaning: God “Creator, Mighty and Strong”. The plural form of Eloah, accommodating the doctrine of the Trinity. Superlative nature of God’s power is evident as God (Elohim) speaks the world into existence.
questions: How does recognizing God as Elohim, the Creator, inspire awe and reverence in my daily life?
In what ways can the concept of God's plural nature (Trinity) deepen my understanding of His relational character?
When I feel chaotic or disorganized, how can I remember Elohim’s power to bring order and creation?

name: EL SHADDAI
meaning: “God Almighty,” “The Mighty One of Jacob.” Speaks to God’s ultimate power over all.
questions: When facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles, how does the name El Shaddai remind me of God's all-sufficient power?
How can I surrender my need for control to El Shaddai, trusting in His ultimate authority?
Reflect on a time you needed God to be "Almighty" for you. How did He show up?

name: ADONAI
meaning: “Lord.” Used in place of YHWH, which was thought by the Jews to be too sacred. YHWH is more often used in God’s dealings with His people, while Adonai is used more when He deals with the Gentiles.
questions: In what areas of my life do I need to more fully acknowledge God as Adonai, my Lord and Master?
How does understanding Adonai's lordship challenge my own desires for autonomy?
What does it practically mean for me to submit to God as Adonai in my decisions today?

name: YHWH / YAHWEH / JEHOVAH
meaning: “LORD.” Strictly speaking, the only proper name for God. Translated “LORD” (all caps). Revealed to Moses as “I Am who I Am” (Exodus 3:14). Specifies immediacy, presence. Yahweh is present, accessible, near to those who call on Him.
questions: How does the name YHWH, "I Am," assure me of God's constant and active presence in my life?
In moments of loneliness or uncertainty, how can I draw comfort from Yahweh's nearness?
What does it mean to me personally that God is eternally self-existent ("I Am who I Am")?

name: YAHWEH-JIREH
meaning: "The Lord Will Provide." Name memorialized by Abraham when God provided the ram for sacrifice.
questions: In what area of my life am I currently needing to trust Yahweh-Jireh to provide?
How can I cultivate a heart of gratitude for God's past provisions, strengthening my faith for future needs?
What fears or anxieties can I release by focusing on God's character as Yahweh-Jireh?

name: YAHWEH-RAPHA
meaning: "The Lord Who Heals." "I am Jehovah who heals you” both in body and soul (preserving from/curing diseases, pardoning iniquities).
questions: In what areas of my life (physical, emotional, spiritual) do I need Yahweh-Rapha's healing touch?
How can I open myself more fully to the healing God offers, whether it's physical recovery or spiritual restoration?
When have I experienced God's healing, and how can I be an instrument of His healing to others?

name: YAHWEH-NISSI
meaning: "The Lord Our Banner." A rallying place. Commemorates desert victory over Amalekites.
questions: What battles am I facing where I need to look to Yahweh-Nissi as my banner and source of victory?
How can I publicly and privately declare my allegiance to God as my rallying point?
In times of discouragement, how does remembering God as Yahweh-Nissi renew my courage?

name: YAHWEH-M'KADDESH
meaning: "The Lord Who Sanctifies, Makes Holy." God alone, not the law, can cleanse His people and make them holy.
questions: In what areas of my character or behavior am I seeking Yahweh-M'Kaddesh's sanctifying work?
How can I cooperate with God's process of making me holy in my daily choices and habits?
What does it mean to live as a "sanctified" person in a practical way today?

name: YAHWEH-SHALOM
meaning: "The Lord Our Peace." Name given by Gideon to an altar after the Angel of the Lord assured him he would not die.
questions: Where in my life do I need to experience the peace of Yahweh-Shalom that surpasses understanding?
How can I cultivate inner peace by trusting in God, even amidst external turmoil?
In what relationships or situations can I be a peacemaker, reflecting Yahweh-Shalom?

name: YAHWEH-ELOHIM
meaning: "LORD God." Combination of God’s unique name YHWH and the generic word for “God,” signifying He is the Lord who is God.
questions: How does understanding God as Yahweh-Elohim deepen my reverence for Him as both the personal, covenant-keeping God (Yahweh) and the all-powerful Creator (Elohim)?
In what ways does this combined name affirm the completeness and sovereignty of God?
How can I worship God more fully by acknowledging both His relational nature and His majestic power?

name: YAHWEH-TSIDKENU
meaning: "The Lord Our Righteousness.” God alone provides righteousness to man, ultimately in Jesus Christ.
questions: How does relying on Yahweh-Tsidkenu free me from the burden of trying to achieve righteousness on my own?
How can I live more confidently in the righteousness God has provided for me through Christ?
In what ways does understanding God as my righteousness motivate me to live justly and compassionately?

name: YAHWEH-ROHI
meaning: "The Lord Our Shepherd." Based on David's reflection on his relationship as a shepherd to his sheep.
questions: In what areas of my life do I need to trust Yahweh-Rohi's guidance and care like a sheep trusts its shepherd?
How can I better listen for the voice of my Shepherd amidst the noise of the world?
What fears or anxieties can I lay down by remembering that Yahweh-Rohi is watching over me?

name: YAHWEH-SHAMMAH
meaning: "The Lord Is There.” Name ascribed to Jerusalem and the Temple, indicating the Lord's returned glory.
questions: How does the promise of Yahweh-Shammah, "The Lord is there," bring comfort and hope, especially in difficult or desolate circumstances?
How can I cultivate a greater awareness of God's presence with me in my everyday moments?
In what future hope or promise do I see Yahweh-Shammah being fully realized?

name: YAHWEH-SABAOTH
meaning: "The Lord of Hosts." Hosts means “hordes” of angels and men. Expressive of majesty, power, and authority of God.
questions: When I feel overwhelmed by worldly powers or spiritual opposition, how does remembering Yahweh-Sabaoth, the Lord of Hosts, strengthen my faith?
How can I align my will with the purposes of the Lord of Hosts in my life and community?
What confidence does it give me to know that the God I serve commands legions of angels and all earthly powers?

name: EL ELYON
meaning: “Most High." Derived from Hebrew root for “go up” or “ascend.” Denotes exaltation and absolute right to lordship.
questions: How does focusing on God as El Elyon, the Most High, help me put my earthly concerns into proper perspective?
In what areas of my life do I need to submit to God's supreme authority and lordship?
How can I cultivate a lifestyle of worship that acknowledges God's exalted position over all creation?

name: EL ROI
meaning: "God of Seeing." Ascribed to God by Hagar. He is a God who lives and sees all.
questions: In times of feeling unseen, forgotten, or misunderstood, how does the name El Roi comfort me?
How does knowing that God sees everything encourage me to live with integrity and compassion?
When have I felt God's specific attention (El Roi) on my situation, and how did it impact me?

name: EL-OLAM
meaning: "Everlasting God." God’s nature is without beginning or end, free from constraints of time. Contains within Himself the cause of time itself.
questions: How does meditating on God as El-Olam, the Everlasting God, provide stability and hope in a constantly changing world?
How does God's timeless nature influence my perspective on my own limited lifespan and priorities?
When I am anxious about the future or regretful of the past, how can El-Olam's eternal presence bring me peace?

name: EL-GIBHOR
meaning: “Mighty God.” Name describing the Messiah, Christ Jesus, in Isaiah. A powerful and mighty warrior who will destroy God’s enemies and rule with a rod of iron.
questions: How does knowing Jesus as El-Gibhor, the Mighty God, empower me to face spiritual battles and challenges?
In what ways can I rely on Christ's strength when I feel weak or defeated?
How does the promise of El-Gibhor's ultimate victory and righteous rule bring me hope for the future?
